entry.question: Formalize the finite nonlinear lattice Hamiltonian H = sum_i [p_i^2/(2 m_i) + (Dq_i)^2/2 + lambda/n*(Dq_i)^n] for n at least 3. Prove the exact algebraic rescaling q=sqrt(epsilon) q_tilde, p=sqrt(epsilon) p_tilde under explicit positivity and real-power hypotheses, identifying effective coupling g=lambda*epsilon^((n-2)/2) and the algebraic identity g^(-2)=lambda^(-2)*epsilon^(-(n-2)) under required nonzero assumptions. This identity must not be presented as a proof of a thermalization time law. Ground Hamiltonian notions against Physlib.ClassicalMechanics.HamiltonsEquations.
